shortDescription: Replace the Kimi Code background with your own image or a gradient
longDescription: Replaces the Kimi Code main background with a local image or a built-in gradient. The wallpaper sits behind the page; the chat area stays transparent while the sidebar, chat header and right panel become translucent so text remains readable. The Wallpaper page in Settings lets you change the image, opacity, blur, veil and surface opacity; the CLI can set an image too. A resident watchdog re-injects the page after Kimi Code updates.
tryPrompts: Use this image as my Kimi Code background
Switch to the midnight gradient wallpaper
Lower the wallpaper opacity so text is easier to read
